trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum comes after the other 54 awards. Check PlayStation for any trophy you might have ticked here by mistake.

steps.text: Use the grades and unearned filter to narrow down the awards still on your list.
Compare the remaining rows against the PS5 trophy screen before planning another run.
The platinum unlocks with the last outstanding award; there is no extra mission.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Start a new story and play the first marked mission through its ending.

steps.text: Play the opening sequence as Jason and follow the main marker into Gone Fishing.
Finish Gone Fishing and check the trophy list once the mission ends. Optional jobs are separate.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: The Chapter 1 award arrives when the story moves forward after Discharge Time.

steps.text: Before leaving Chapter 1, make a manual save and check the balcony precaution on the roadmap.
Finish Discharge Time and continue into Chapter 2 before checking the PS5 trophy screen.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 main missions and play the handoff to Vice City.

steps.text: Follow the Paradise Lost chapter’s main markers through its closing mission.
Enter Chapter 3 through Welcome to Vice City and check that the bronze posted.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Stay on the main story through the third chapter and let the next chapter begin.

steps.text: Use the Chapter 3 mission order if the map is crowded with optional contacts.
Finish the closing story mission, then continue into Chapter 4 to register the chapter award.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: This award belongs to the Chapter 4 ending. The game’s final mission has its own trophy.

steps.text: Make a manual save before the end of Chapter 4 if you still want to revisit its optional jobs.
Play across the Chapter 4 to Chapter 5 transition and check the trophy list.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold follows The End of the Road, the final mission of Chapter 5.

steps.text: Follow the final chapter’s main markers to The End of the Road and finish the mission.
After the credits, use free roam for cleanup and open the new 100% Completion panel.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Follow the Chapter 2 motel sequence in Port Gellhorn until Breakfast Run appears.

steps.text: Return to the main mission marker in Port Gellhorn when you are ready to leave side activities.
Finish Breakfast Run through its ending and verify the bronze called Trust.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Follow Chapter 3 to The Cartel Heist. Ordinary bank jobs do not satisfy this story award.

steps.text: Continue the Chapter 3 main missions until the heist is offered.
Complete the heist’s marked objectives and wait for the wrap-up before checking the trophy list.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Look for Child’s Play on the Chapter 4 story route.

steps.text: Keep advancing the main objectives until Child’s Play becomes active.
Finish the mission. The official trophy lists completion and gives no medal requirement.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Use the Chapter 4 story marker for Headliners rather than a side appearance by Dimez.

steps.text: Advance the Chapter 4 main sequence until Headliners opens.
Play the mission through to its closing objectives and look for the bronze when it ends.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the airport mission in Chapter 4. The separate VCIA free roam trophy uses a different route.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 4 story to VCIA Takedown, the airport job.
Finish the story job and check the PS5 awards after the mission wraps.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory opens during Chapter 5 and triggers Snow Storm at completion.

steps.text: Continue the main story after the Chapter 4 airport sequence.
Complete Operation Savage Glory once it is available and confirm the award in the PS5 list.

trophies.availability: Earned during the main story at the stated milestone.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, clear the weighted 100% checklist. Some trophy counters stop earlier than their completion targets.

steps.text: Open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion after the story. Your earlier work carries over.
Clear 39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, seven payday loans and all eight vaults. Collect the key valuables at each operation.
Finish 42 range golds, 42 drone trials, 33 underwater discoveries and 15 Bret Target Decks.
Aim for 300 stunts, 70 challenges, 15 card sets, 15 meditations, 100 WAiNK locations and 200 vehicle models.
Check the in-game targets for Optional Tasks, Stick Ups and Marked Bills. Track eight qualifying Stranger strands separately for the platinum.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Use the stunt map for variety. The silver needs 250 completions; 100% needs 300.

steps.text: Open the Stunt Spots map and choose nearby entries you have not completed.
Mix jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps to fill the counter.
Watch the Progress counter after each batch. Tick the silver at 250 and keep going to 300 for 100%.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample all nine activity types once. Check which types are missing before traveling to another area.

steps.text: Open Progress → Activities and note your missing categories.
Try fishing, hunting, golf, range shooting, pool, basketball, arcade play, a race and a stunt.
Return to the activity panel after each batch. A race win covers only the racing slot.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every Shooting Range challenge. The same set counts toward 100%.

steps.text: Pick a Shooting Range on the activity map and read each displayed gold target before starting.
Repeat challenges at the current range until every result is gold, then move to the next venue.
Check off all 42 golds across 12 ranges. The practice also helps build Combat Focus for Gunslinger.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win at each of the 14 Top Fun venues. Work through three trials per venue if you also want 100%.

steps.text: Use the activity map to find a Top Fun Drone Race and register a win there.
Move to a different venue after a win. A repeat at the same location cannot fill an empty slot.
Track 14 distinct venue wins for the trophy and 42 trial completions for the 100% checklist.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 distinct race events. Save repeat runs for practice instead of counting them toward the trophy.

steps.text: Choose an event from a race marker and finish in first place.
After a win, pick a course you have not won and repeat until the unique-win count reaches 20.
Continue toward 30 of 40 different wins if you are also working on 100%.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal’s invitation after the introduction in Feng Shui. Win the challenge he offers.

steps.text: Play Feng Shui and watch for Cal’s follow-up when the mission ends.
Go to the marked fishing spot and beat Cal in his challenge. An ordinary fishing session will not trigger this trophy.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade game all the way through. A cabinet or one of the home TV games can get you started.

steps.text: Choose an available game from a TV or arcade cabinet.
Play until the game records an ending before you leave the activity.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Lucia starts Andy’s five-job strand in Belville once his Chapter 3 message arrives.

steps.text: Switch to Lucia in Chapter 3 and follow Andy’s text to Belville.
Work through Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee and Peach! in the order offered.
Complete Read the Label and then Puff Puff Pass. You can return to the strand after the story.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton’s shipwreck assignments through the seventh treasure. If his marker disappears, let the story advance.

steps.text: Meet Kenton at the green KR marker in Key Lento after his introduction.
At the purple chest markers, dive and use the detector to recover the wreck treasures.
Check the Kenton’s Treasures collection for missing assignments. Wait for his later text to Jason if the strand pauses.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy’s Thrillbilly Mud Club strand ends with Hometown Heroes, the fifth job.

steps.text: Meet Billy at the club when his Chapter 2 strand becomes available.
Take his follow-up missions as they arrive and finish Hometown Heroes to claim the award.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Count completed strands in the trophy tracker. A personal trophy for a character does not prove their strand qualifies.

steps.text: Start with the four reported qualifying contacts: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. Play each chain to its finale.
Compare the PS5 counter before and after each finale; allow in-game days for texts and later chapters to open.
Continue until eight strands register. The consulted pages do not confirm the full qualifying roster.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy’s garage in west Vice City requests 16 sports cars after the Key Cloner introduction.

steps.text: Finish Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ GS in Chapter 3, then follow the RK marker to Randy’s Wish List.
Use WAiNK to match cars to the request list. Check hotel driveways in Vice Beach and Ocean Beach.
Deliver each requested model and finish the final job. Better-condition deliveries pay more.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Start Tyrone’s Chapter 3 strand as Jason and follow the lab jobs to the finale.

steps.text: Complete Here, Kitty Kitty so Tyrone can offer the first job.
Follow the purple lab markers. Continue to the next assignment rather than repeating a cleared site.
Finish the final listed Tyrone mission and check the trophy screen.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Take Lucia’s balcony invitation before Chapter 1 closes, then aim for 18 recorded sessions. The 100% checklist asks for 15.

steps.text: After Down to Earth, return to Jason’s house the next morning. Talk to Lucia in the kitchen, then accept on the balcony.
Keep a Chapter 1 save. The invitation disappears later; the guides do not confirm whether this session counts as mandatory.
Reunite Jason and Lucia after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). A joint meditation counts twice; the last spot requires both leads.
Check Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations. Track 18 for the trophy and 15 for 100%.

trophies.availability: Balcony first in Chapter 1; explore with both leads after Coffee Break.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret’s hunting jobs begin in Chapter 2. Complete the assignment for a unique animal.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, open Bret’s hunting strand and pick the unique animal on a Target Deck.
Hunt that animal as Jason and finish any marked turn-in objective. A wildlife observation alone does not count.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Choose three card sets that are close to complete, then use the card reference to find their missing pieces.

steps.text: Open Progress → Collections and compare the set counters. Pick three sets to finish first.
Look up the missing cards in the collection reference and check residences and garages while exploring.
Verify that three full sets register. Keep collecting toward 15 of 18 sets for 100%.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 places with WAiNK. Vehicle scans go into a separate collection.

steps.text: At a WAiNK prompt, press D-pad Up and hold R1 to scan the place or object.
Cover the 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, then use billboards and road tags for the remainder.
Try the Derelict Spy Vessel in Permit Keys or the Mermaid Display at Vice City Oceanarium when you are nearby.
Check the location total against the 108 listed by IGN; any 100 distinct scans also meet the 100% target.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 tracked challenges for the silver. Keep going to 70 for the completion checklist.

steps.text: Open Progress → Challenges and pick unfinished entries that match your next activities.
Complete their listed tasks. Reopen the counter after a session to see which ones registered.
Check for the trophy at 50 completed challenges and the separate 100% target at 70.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Keep both leads together until the four-star pursuit and the remaining Heat have cleared.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner through the character menu and travel together.
Use an in-game vault job later in the story, or another activity that raises your Wanted Level to four stars.
Break police sight and move out of the red Heat zone. The trophy guide suggests the tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County.
Stay with your partner until the recognition indicators clear, then verify the trophy.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Plan three nearby in-game shop stops and keep your partner and the Wanted indicator through the third stop.

steps.text: After Yasmani’s introduction, the trophy guide suggests the three jewelry shops in north Vice City as a short route.
Complete the shops in sequence without allowing the game’s Wanted indicator to clear between stops.
Wait for the award before ending the chase. The guide reports a delay and suggests an extra stop if it has not registered.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicle models with WAiNK. Buying or keeping the vehicles is optional.

steps.text: Open WAiNK near traffic and scan vehicles you have not discovered.
Visit different areas to vary the traffic. Scanning another copy of the same model does not add a discovery.
Check the Vehicles collection for the award at 100. The 100% checklist asks for 200 models.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In the game, keep one Combat Focus activation running for five eligible takedowns.

steps.text: Start with a full Focus meter and choose a gang encounter with at least five game enemies.
While aiming, click L3 and R3 together. Finish all five before that activation runs out.
If the game does not count the encounter, refill Focus and try a fresh gang operation. Range medals also help build Focus.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: The trophy guide points to a boarding-bridge jet at VCIA during free roam.

steps.text: At the airport terminal, check bridge gates E3 and E4 for an attached passenger jet.
Use the game’s aircraft controls to depart, leave the pursuit area and confirm the award.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Look for an in-game Rhino at Mile Zero Air Station on Mariana.

steps.text: Visit the southwest island and look near the southern part of the air station for the Rhino.
Use the Rhino against the game’s base hostiles, then finish the encounter and check the trophy list.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani’s Chapter 3 introduction gives you the Snap Gun for a quiet jewelry job.

steps.text: Complete Jewelry Jobs to unlock the tool before trying the trophy.
At a game jewelry store such as Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds, use the Snap Gun on the rear entrance.
Find the safe-code note in the back room, clear the marked safe and leave without raising the alarm.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Open the Chapter 4 vault activity and log five different successful escapes. The 100% checklist needs eight.

steps.text: Finish That’s Where the Money Is… and follow the game’s security-van objective to a vault.
Complete the in-game cash pickup. Bringing your partner lets the game track a second bag.
Clear the game’s four-star chase and Heat, then repeat at a different vault.
Check the count at five for the trophy. Yasmani offers van tips after his earlier jobs; use them for the eight-vault cleanup if needed.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Use the game’s armored truck encounter and clear the Heat after collecting its cargo.

steps.text: Find an armored truck encounter in free roam and use the game’s sticky-bomb interaction on its cargo doors.
Collect the cash and clear the on-screen pursuit and Heat. The guide also reports vault jobs as a possible alternate trigger.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the remaining fog on Leonida’s world map.

steps.text: Zoom out and find unexplored patches, especially around the edges and coast.
Visit the gaps by road, boat or aircraft, then check the map after each pass.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Complete one marked operation for each of Leonida’s nine gangs.

steps.text: Pick a yellow illegal-operation marker for a gang you have not yet checked off.
Look at the map marker for remaining key valuables and finish the operation’s requirements.
Verify all nine groups in Progress → Gangs. Clear all 39 operations separately for 100%.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The source gives an Ocean Beach cocktail clue but no tested venue or trigger.

steps.text: Keep this flagged for Ocean Beach exploration. The description does not identify a bar or a specific time.
Check the cited trophy guides for a confirmed venue before planning a detour.

trophies.availability: Timing and unlock conditions remain unverified.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: A vehicle showroom is the only location clue. The required vehicle and setup remain unconfirmed.

steps.text: Look for a tested showroom route in the cited trophy references before spending on a vehicle.
Keep a manual save if trying the clue in-game. Tick it only when PlayStation registers the award.

trophies.availability: Timing and unlock conditions remain unverified.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Clear the three valuables at the Kingpin Bowling operation in Port Gellhorn, then leave the in-game pursuit.

steps.text: After Hit Kingpin Bowling opens in Chapter 2, go to the Kolt & Associates alley.
Check the southeast office for the watch, the northeast table for the Gutterball Moreland 850 and the northeast hall for the safe.
Escape in the game and verify the award. The guide says repeat visits can count, but the site takes time to respawn.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Raise Strength to maximum on both playable characters. Check their profiles separately.

steps.text: Take your partner to a gym or fitness-club activity and train together when possible.
Open each character’s stat screen. Train the one who is still short of maximum.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The guide reports 500 profile-affecting actions. No particular direction on the Criminal Profile meter is required.

steps.text: Enable Criminal Profile notifications under Settings → UI and watch for qualifying events in normal play.
Track those events toward 500 rather than forcing a particular profile state.
Keep an earlier save if you want to avoid a permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The second-attempt wording has no verified activity or location in the cited sources.

steps.text: Keep the official clue on the unresolved list. It does not state that a race or mission must fail.
Look for a tested update on either trophy guide and mark progress only after a console unlock.

trophies.availability: Timing and unlock conditions remain unverified.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official joke description has no verified event attached to it in the sources reviewed.

steps.text: The trophy list gives no location, counter or mission. Leave the checklist open for a later discovery.
Check the guide updates before treating a rumored encounter as the unlock condition.

trophies.availability: Timing and unlock conditions remain unverified.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The PlayStation clue names a melee drive-by but leaves the target and vehicle unspecified.

steps.text: Keep this on the unresolved list. The bowling pun does not identify the bowling alley as the location.
Use a tested setup from the linked sources if one appears; confirm against the PS5 notification.

trophies.availability: Timing and unlock conditions remain unverified.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Track the amount laundered through contacts, since picking up Marked Bills is only the first part.

steps.text: Follow the story until contacts accept marked cash. Collect Marked Bills from the associated in-game jobs.
Return to a contact to launder the bills and check the trophy’s running total until it reaches $250,000.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Shop purchases accumulate toward $100,000. Check what your normal purchases have already covered.

steps.text: Buy the gear and supplies needed for your remaining trophies as shops open.
Check cumulative shop spending and use optional purchases to close the gap to $100,000.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Check the property listings for unowned garages and reserve cash for all of them.

steps.text: Use the property icons and listings to identify every garage you still need to buy.
Purchase the remaining garages as funds allow, then confirm the trophy on PlayStation.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles in Scooter Bros. Leave room in your garage before paying for another.

steps.text: Use Moses in Port Gellhorn for untracked vehicles in Chapter 2. From Chapter 3, Pay ’n’ Spray also handles tracked models.
Bring a vehicle to the registration service, pay the fee and verify it appears in Scooter Bros.
Repeat to ten registrations. If the next registration is blocked, check for free garage space.

trophies.availability: The consulted sources identify no trophy lockout for this route.

roadmap.title: Protect the one risky window
roadmap.note: Possible missable · do Lucia’s balcony meditation when it appears; trophy dependency is unconfirmed.

steps.text: Keep a Chapter 1 save and accept Lucia’s balcony meditation. Its trophy requirement is unconfirmed.
Finish Gone Fishing, then follow the main story into Chapter 2.
Get Shirley’s Rum and Steal the Scooter can expire. Neither gates a trophy or 100%.

roadmap.title: Build your activity counters
roadmap.note: Start repeatable hobbies early; counters survive story progress.

steps.text: Try all nine activities for Master of None: fishing, hunting, golf, range, pool, basketball, arcade, racing and stunts.
Take Bret’s hunt, beat Cal at fishing and finish Billy’s dirt-bike strand.
Scan vehicle models and WAiNK locations as you explore. The 100% checklist asks for 200 models and 100 locations.

roadmap.title: Work the Vice City strands
roadmap.note: Optional character trophies · finish strand-specific jobs after they begin.

steps.text: After Key Cloner, start the available jobs for Andy, Randy, Yasmani and Tyrone.
Finish eight qualifying strands for Strangers & Freaks. Use the trophy counter to confirm each strand counts.
Do Yago’s race and optional phone jobs when offered if you want side-content completion.

roadmap.title: Open the vault route & finish the story
roadmap.note: Do the Chapter 4 vault introduction before relying on the bank counter; free roam continues after credits.

steps.text: That’s Where the Money Is… opens vault jobs. Escape five vaults for the trophy; clear all eight for 100%.
This Is a Free Call From… can expire without costing a trophy.
Finish VCIA Takedown, Operation Savage Glory and The End of the Road for the remaining mission trophies.

roadmap.title: Finish the tracker, then take the platinum
roadmap.note: The actual in-game completion checklist is authoritative when sources disagree.

steps.text: After the credits, open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Earlier work counts.
Full sets include 42 range golds, 42 drone trials, eight vaults, 39 gang operations and 15 Bret Target Decks.
Log eight qualifying Stranger strands separately. Sources disagree on their 100% credit.
Verify the game’s 100% state and all 54 other PS5 trophies; Vice Got a Price! then completes the set.

entries.name: Positive Mental Attitude
entries.action: Accept the balcony meditation when prompted; save before Chapter 1 closes.
entries.confidence: The location is time-limited; whether it is required by the trophy remains unconfirmed.

missableAudit.clarification: Other chapter-limited optional missions can be missed, but the cited completion guide says they do not block a trophy or 100% completion.

disputes.title: Balcony meditation: precaution, not a proven requirement
disputes.text: The trophy guide says Lucia’s Chapter 1 balcony spot disappears and labels the trophy possibly missable; it also says the spot’s requirement has not been confirmed. Do the meditation before leaving Chapter 1 and keep a save. The audit does not claim a proven platinum lockout.

disputes.title: Do Strangers & Freaks strands count toward 100%?
disputes.text: GTABase’s trophy guide says the eight strands are not part of 100%; its 100% checklist says Stranger quests contribute to Optional Tasks. Treat the in-game 100% tracker as decisive; finish eight separately for the trophy.

disputes.title: Time-limited side missions are not trophy missables
disputes.text: The story guide marks selected optional missions as chapter-limited, while the 100% guide says none are needed for 100%. Preserve a manual save if you want every side job, but do not label those windows as trophy requirements.

disputes.title: Cryptic descriptions remain explicitly unresolved
disputes.text: The consulted trophy guide has no verified trigger for In The Beginning… and notes uncertainty around several joke-description trophies. The steps label those routes as leads, not facts; recheck the linked source instead of trusting folklore.

disputes.title: Early 100% guides disagree on counters
disputes.text: IGN’s table gives 100 Stick Ups and $100,000 Marked Bills, while GTABase lists 50 distinct Stick Ups and $250,000 Marked Bills. IGN’s prose also says all optional missions; GTABase lists 100 Optional Tasks. Follow the game’s Progress screen. Dime on the Dollar itself explicitly requires $250,000.

disputes.title: Eighteen meditations for trophy; fifteen for 100%
disputes.text: The official description says every spot. GTABase and KeenGamer report 18 meditation sessions for the trophy, while the 100% list needs 15. The balcony is time-limited but its necessity remains unconfirmed. Safest route: do it in Chapter 1 and retain a save.
